heroText: We send this week's list to your eBag cart. You order and pay on eBag yourself — we can't place orders.

errors.denied: You didn't allow access on eBag. You can try again any time.
errors.state: Connecting timed out or was interrupted. Please try again.
errors.exchange: eBag didn't confirm the connection. Try again in a moment.
errors.ebag: eBag returned an error. Try again in a moment.
errors.start: We couldn't reach eBag. Try again in a moment.
errors.disconnect: We couldn't disconnect. Please try again.

connectText: You'll log in to eBag.bg and allow “Shopping Plan” to add products to your cart. Your password stays with eBag — we only keep an encrypted key to your cart. You can disconnect any time.
noPlan: You don't have a plan yet. Create a weekly plan, then send it to the cart.
summary: {n, plural, one {# product} other {# products}} · about {amount} at prices from {date}
weekListNote: We check availability before adding. Sold-out items are swapped for a similar product. Whatever is already in your cart stays.
sendOffline: No connection. Check your internet and try again — products already added stay in the cart.
checking: Checking availability of every product — about a minute.
sentDone: Done: {n} of {total} products are in your cart.
missingLine: {ingredient}: sold out, no substitute — buy it elsewhere
changeFailed: The change didn't go through. Please try again.
changeOffline: No connection. The change wasn't saved.
soldOut: Sold out — remove or replace it
belowMin: {amount} more to reach eBag's minimum order.
orderNote: You pick the delivery time and pay on eBag — we can't place orders.

api.qtyAdjusted: eBag adjusted the quantity to what's in stock.
api.changeRejected: eBag didn't accept the change — see the current cart.
api.expired: Your eBag connection has expired. Connect your account again.
api.down: eBag isn't responding right now. Try again in a moment.
